d: China’s Communist Party has expelled a record 33 officials during a key leadership meeting, as President Xi Jinping continues a sweeping anti-corruption and discipline campaign. Only 279 of the 376 Central Committee members named in 2022 attended the latest plenum, leaving 97 seats empty. The military has been particularly affected: five of the seven members appointed to the Central Military Commission in 2022 have been purged, leaving Xi and Zhang Shengmin as its remaining members.
